name: Twisterspell
lore: A cheerful weather apprentice who collects river mist in her hat. She tends Crossroads’ new Mistglass Spire, turning unruly breezes into carefully bottled spells.

primary.name: Pocket Twister
primary.description: Hold LMB, then release a curved funnel. Charge caps at 1.6s: 6–14.4 damage per 0.5s and 36–61 radius. Up to four funnels last 4.2s. All slow 30%; full charge strongly pulls foes from nearby. Lightning unlocks with the passive.
primary.ui_brief: Charged funnel • wider damage area • strong full-charge pull

secondary.name: Whirlaway
secondary.description: Become a controllable tornado for 3 seconds: +20% speed with a gentle weaving path. Swallow nearby hostile projectiles, deal 7 damage every 0.5s and slow nearby foes 30%. No invulnerability.

special.name: Hail, Please!
special.description: Stand still and channel for 2 seconds, then summon 12 hailstones over 3.6 seconds around the casting spot. Each warned landing deals 16 damage and stuns foes for 0.6s. Ice never hits allies.

passive: Storm Circuit: three or more primary funnels arc lightning between them every 1.25s. Enemies crossing a link take 8 damage and a 0.35s stun. A full-charge funnel can also zap a nearby foe for 10 damage every 1.5s. A foe can be shocked at most once per second per caster.

technique.name: Wide Forecast
technique.description: Trade four funnels for two wider ones: slightly lower damage and no three-funnel circuit, but full-charge direct lightning still works.

attack.name: Wide Forecast
attack.description: Charge wider, lighter funnels: 5–12 damage per 0.5s, 48–82 radius. Maximum two. Full charge strongly pulls and, with Storm Circuit unlocked, zaps nearby foes.

final_technique.name: Sleet Stitch
final_technique.description: Trade random surrounding hail and brief stuns for a directed line of heavier ice and longer slows.

attack.name: Sleet Stitch
attack.description: Channel in place for 1 second, then stitch 12 warned icy landings along the aimed corridor. Each deals 20 damage and slows 45% for 3 seconds; no stun.
